trades.name: Hold/LBAF of 29208-29241
trades.quote: Long a hold or LBAF of 208-241 is a B/B-. It would normally be way lower given such a bearish trend but I’m upgrading it a bit given how extended this move is and how important the bull gap is.

trades.name: Failed pop within today's range (sell response 29339-29395)
trades.quote: I’m willing to join any downtrend coming from a failed pop within today’s range. There is far less clarity in the NQ profile as compared to ES, but meaningful supply. I start looking for a sell response as low as 339, but even something like 395 can look reasonably bullish but just be a pop to sell. This isn’t a very specific trade idea but hilariously still rates a B+

trades.name: Fail/LAAF of 7710-7713
trades.quote: Short a fail/LAAF of 7710-7713. While I feel like stronger sellers would defend by 90-92, it is not unreasonable to expect relief that could just end up being a sell. B-
